content:
There is a snippet by Leo here where he uses a "view" (see the paper about these, The view from the left) to wrap the constructors of an inductive type in another set of constructors. I was wondering, are there any examples of codebases that make extensive usage of this idea?

This can be used to wrap subtypes of an inductive type in constructors that more directly correspond to what would be an ideal API, e.g. a nonempty list subtype with two constructors, singleton and cons (the match-pattern attribute will not work for this case, making the view-pattern the only way to achieve this sort of more ergonomic API)
